comparisons.limitation: INSCRIBE explicitly pairs HT 29 with 81951, citing the same GORILA edition. Its room 59? findspot retains the source question mark. Museum MPE 81951 text still does not itself name HT 29. The edition HM 9 cast remains distinct; source independence is not established.

INSCRIBE explicitly pairs HT 114 with 83735 and cites the same GORILA edition. Shared wording or citation does not establish independent verification. Recto/verso naming is retained at project level; no graphical face alignment is newly certified.
INSCRIBE pairs HT 118 with 83734 and cites GORILA I pp.200–201. Its administrative-content interpretation is not imported. No modern identity certification or independent confirmation is asserted.

Project inventory 8 and Chania, odos Katre findspot are attributed reports. Its LM I and the pinned source LM IB are kept separately without adopting a canonical date or treating differing specificity as a resolved dispute. No inventory caption is invented in the critical pilot.
